assumptions: The blackout interval is the interval beginning at 00:00 on 2026-01-28 and ending when STREAMS 2 resumes at 09:00 on 2026-02-02.

citations.quote: the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2 (hereafter referred to as the “blackout period of STREAMS”);

children.distinction: This child fixes the temporal attachment of the blackout arrangement. The source specifies times as well as dates, which this formal fragment cannot represent with a date-only fact.
questions: Can the exact time-bounded interval be represented in the governing authority or another approved formalism?
children.statement: The blackout period runs from 00:00 on 2026-01-28 until 09:00 on 2026-02-02.
children.subject: Blackout interval

citations.quote: for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

children.distinction: The child preserves the source's please wording as a direction to contact JFIU. It does not assert that contact completes filing or satisfies any later STREAMS 2 resubmission requirement.

citations.quote: for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

children.distinction: The authorities establish a post-implementation resubmission rule for STRs submitted through other channels, but do not state whether or what follow-up applies to a blackout-only urgent contact. The parent question therefore remains unresolved.
